snippet.title: Scars of Honor – Showcase Recap & Community Q&A | Playtests Coming 2026
snippet.description:
After our recent showcase, we received a lot of questions from the community about some of the systems we showed.

In this video, we revisit key parts of the showcase and answer common community questions about the Scar system, combat targeting and feel, and procedural dungeons, clarifying how these systems work and what to expect going forward.

We also share what’s coming next for Scars of Honor, including our first community playtest planned for Spring 2026.

🔗 Wishlist Scars of Honor on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4253010/Scars_of_Honor/
💬 Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/scarsofhonor
